files.description: 2-page Riverside County Sheriff collision report. Case #RC-2026-05-20-4471. Date: May 20, 2026. Location: Intersection of Main St & Oak Ave, Riverside, CA. Vehicles: 2020 Honda Accord (insured - Michael Chen) rear-ended by 2022 Ford F-150 (at-fault - James Morton). Fault: 100% James Morton (ran red light per witness + traffic camera). Injuries: Minor (Chen - neck strain, declined ambulance). Damage: Moderate rear-end damage to Honda Accord. Narrative includes witness statement confirming light was red for Morton.

3-minute recorded statement from Michael Chen. Key details: Was stopped at red light on Main St, heard tires screech, felt heavy impact from behind. Car pushed into intersection. Airbags did not deploy. Got out, saw extensive rear damage. Other driver admitted fault at scene. Neck pain started next day. Vehicle is a 2020 Honda Accord EX-L, purchased new, 42,000 miles. Uses it for daily commute and family transport. Mentions taking it to Apex Collision Center (recommended by a friend).
files.tts_voice: male, mid-30s, slightly anxious but cooperative

files.description: Front view of 2020 Honda Accord. Minor scratches on front bumper from being pushed forward. Mostly cosmetic. License plate slightly bent.
files.notes: Find/stage: silver Honda Accord with very minor front damage

files.description: CRITICAL: Rear-left view showing MODERATE BUMPER DAMAGE ONLY. Bumper cracked/displaced, paint transfer, minor denting. The QUARTER PANEL IS INTACT — only cosmetic scuffing. This photo contradicts the body shop estimate which claims full quarter panel replacement.
files.notes: Must clearly show bumper damage but intact quarter panel. This is the cross-modal trap.

files.description: Rear-right view showing minor collateral damage — small dent in rear bumper corner, taillight housing cracked.
Interior rear cargo area showing slight warping of trunk floor. Suggests possible structural impact transmitted through rear. Trunk does not close flush.

properties.injury_claim: Minor — neck strain, treating with chiropractor (separate BI claim)
